findings.evidence: Kostant/Form.lean:104 `def kostantGenerators (e : ι → L) (h : κ → L) : Set (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra ℚ L) := kostantRootGenerators e ∪ kostantCartanGenerators h`, whose bodies (lines 91-100) are `range fun p => Associative.dividedPower p.2 (ι ℚ (e p.1))` and `range fun p => Ring.choose (ι ℚ (h p.1)) p.2`; KostantSpan.lean:323 defines a second `kostantGenerators` in namespace `TauCeti.Sl2`, and its own docstring (lines 318-322) states it is "distinct from the indexed family `TauCeti.UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.kostantGenerators`", with KostantSpan.lean:395-403 proving the two agree at rank one.
findings.fix: Generalize the existing definitions to an abstract ℚ-algebra: `def kostantGenerators {A} [Ring A] [Algebra ℚ A] (E : ι → A) (H : κ → A) : Set A := range (fun p : ι × ℕ => dividedPower p.2 (E p.1)) ∪ range (fun p : κ × ℕ => Ring.choose (H p.1) p.2)` (and likewise `kostantForm`), with the `U(L)` versions being that applied to `ι ℚ ∘ e`, `ι ℚ ∘ h`. Then state the rank-one results with `kostantGenerators ![F, E] ![H]` and delete both `Sl2.kostantGenerators` and the bridging lemma. If the cross-file churn is judged out of scope, the minimal alternative is to drop `Sl2.kostantGenerators` and phrase lines 337-383 in terms of `Subring.closure (orderedKostantMonomials H E F)`, which the PR already proves equal, plus a direct `kostantForm ![e,f] ![h] = Subring.closure (orderedKostantMonomials (ι ℚ h) (ι ℚ e) (ι ℚ f))`.
findings.issue: `Sl2.kostantGenerators H E F` is a fixed rank-one specialization of `UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.kostantGenerators e h`, whose definition (Kostant/Form.lean:91-116) uses nothing about `U(L)` beyond applying `ι ℚ` — it is just divided powers and `Ring.choose` of designated elements plus `Subring.closure`. The natural level is one indexed generator set in an arbitrary `[Ring A] [Algebra ℚ A]`; the PR instead adds a second, weaker definition of the same notion and then needs `kostantGenerators_eq_universalEnveloping` (line 395) to glue the two together.

summary: Hypotheses are at the right (weakest) level and the abstract-algebra setting is correct, but the PR introduces a rank-one special-case definition `Sl2.kostantGenerators` instead of lifting the existing indexed `UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.kostantGenerators`/`kostantForm` to an abstract ℚ-algebra, which is the level those definitions actually live at.
